domain.summary: Lyntai (灵台): a .NET 10 library, shipped as NuGet packages, for building LLM applications: one ITextClient front door routing and failing over across providers, pluggable storage, and the LLM-ops layer (prompts, scoring, traces, long-term memory, jobs, media generation).
owns: the LLM provider abstraction: the ITextClient front door, TextRouter/MediaRouter fallback and the ProviderVerdict taxonomy (src/Lyntai.Core/Inference)
the provider adapters: CLI, HTTP, in-process LlamaSharp and ONNX, bridged (src/Lyntai.Providers.*)
the storage domain interfaces and their SQLite, PostgreSQL, in-memory and file-system backends, with every lyntai_* table and its migrations (src/Lyntai.Core/Storage, src/Lyntai.Storage.*)
long-term memory: named memory engines, the graph memory policies, semantic memory and the vector store (src/Lyntai.Core/Memory)
the LLM-ops layer: prompt registry, scorers and evaluation, run traces, usage budget, response cache, rate limits (src/Lyntai.Core)
durable jobs, tool calling and agent sessions, MCP tools in both directions, guards, the secret vault (src/Lyntai.Core, src/Lyntai.Tools.Mcp, src/Lyntai.Secrets.Dpapi)
the public API surface of every Lyntai package and its baselines (tests/Lyntai.Tests/Api/Baselines)
accepts: a capability an application needs from an LLM library, stated as the general need rather than the application's shape
a new provider, storage backend, scorer, generation backend or memory policy behind an existing seam
a defect in routing, fallback, storage, memory recall or any shipped package
a question about what Lyntai promises: its public surface, its data, how a figure it reports is derived
an upgrade question for a consumer moving between Lyntai releases
